_meta.title: Session 42 — ESM Cambrian / ESMFold2 paper (Biohub + EvolutionaryScale, 2026): pLM scaling + protein structure prediction SOTA
_meta.context: Deep-mine of 'Language Modeling Materializes a World Model of Protein Biology' (Candido et al., ~45 authors, Biohub + EvolutionaryScale, Copyright 2026). PDF accessed via presigned S3 URL (bhp-papers-prod) — 71 MB, 104 pages, archived locally as resource/esm_cambrian_esmfold2_biohub_evolutionaryscale.pdf. Introduces 5 new models (ESMC 300M/600M/6B protein language models + ESMFold2 / ESMFold2-Fast structure prediction) trained on UniRef 83M + MGnify 372M + JGI 2B = 2.8B sequences. Introduces FoldBench (multi-modality folding eval — Antibody-Antigen + PPI + Protein-Ligand + Protein-DNA + Protein-Peptide + Monomer) and EC-CATH (enzyme class prediction). KEY SOTA: ESMFold2 + MSA reaches 76% PPI (vs AlphaFold3 73%), 53% AbAg (vs AF3 47%). ESMFold2-Fast 9.4s at L=1024 (vs AF3 ~20.5s = 2.2x faster). ESMC 6B contact precision 0.725 vs ESM2-15B 0.593 (+22%, R²=0.99 scaling law).
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. Every triple verified by agent extraction of TEXT TABLES on PDF pp.6 + §A.1.4.1 + §A.1.4.4 + §A.2.10 + §A.2.11. EXCLUDED figure-only: Figure S6 monomer LDDTs for Chai-1/OpenFold3/Boltz-2/AF3/Protenix-v1 (bar chart only); Figure S7 per-modality bars for OpenFold3/Boltz-2/AF3/Protenix-v1; Figure 3A target-specific hit rates 36-88% minibinder / 15-29% scFv (range in text, not per-target); de novo binder design IC50/affinity values (single-experimental, not multi-model). EXCLUDED EC-CATH bench (ESMC 6B 'best on 53/73 tasks' is task-win-rate not standardized MCC value). FoldBench MSA variant ingested as canonical for ESMFold2 + AlphaFold3 (matches paper's headline comparison); single-seq for ESMFold2-Fast (the fast variant doesn't take MSA). Chai-1 / OpenFold-3 / Protenix-v1 comparison values are coverage-count or figure-only → skipped (chai/chai-1 and openfold/openfold-3 already in DB, no ingestible scores from this paper).

models.name: ESMC 300M
models._note: ESM Cambrian 333M-param protein language model (30 layers, d=960). Trained on 2.8B sequences (UniRef + MGnify + JGI). Contact precision P@L-LR 0.552.

models.name: ESMC 600M
models._note: ESM Cambrian 575M-param pLM (36 layers, d=1152). P@L-LR 0.589 — matches ESM2-15B with 26x fewer params.

models.name: ESMC 6B
models._note: ESM Cambrian flagship 6.35B-param pLM (80 layers, d=2560). SOTA contact precision P@L-LR 0.725 (+22% over ESM2-15B). Scaling law R²=0.99.

models.name: ESMFold2
models._note: Multi-modality structure prediction model (single-seq + MSA, 48 pair folding layers). FoldBench MSA SOTA: PPI 76% (vs AF3 73%), AbAg 53% (vs AF3 47%). Recent-PDB PPI 77% beats Boltz-2 70%. Latency 15.8s at L=1024 (1.3x faster than AF3).

models.name: ESMFold2-Fast
models._note: Fast single-seq-only variant (24 pair folding layers). Latency 9.4s at L=1024 — fastest folder evaluated (2.2x faster than AF3). Single-seq FoldBench: AbAg 50% / PPI 68% / Protein-Ligand 55%.

models.name: ESM2 15B
models._note: Meta ESM2 15B-param baseline pLM. Contact precision P@L-LR 0.593 — top of ESM2 family. Now superseded by ESMC 6B (0.725) at ~2.4x smaller param count when matched to 6B variant.

models.name: Boltz-2
models._note: MIT open-source protein structure prediction model (successor to Boltz-1). Recent-PDB PPI 70% — strong baseline beaten by ESMFold2 (77%, +7pp).

benchmarks.name: Contact Precision @ L (Long-Range)
benchmarks.description: Unsupervised contact prediction precision at top-L long-range residue pairs (|i-j|>24). Higher=better. Standard protein language model evaluation metric. ESM Cambrian paper §A.1.4.1. Scaling law fit R²=0.99: P@L-LR = 0.115*log10(FLOPs) - 1.982.

benchmarks.name: FoldBench Antibody-Antigen DockQ Pass Rate
benchmarks.description: FoldBench Antibody-Antigen interface folding — 172 low-homology AbAg targets, DockQ pass-rate at ≥0.23 (acceptable). Higher=better. Hardest folding modality. ESM Cambrian paper introduces FoldBench (ref 33).

benchmarks.name: FoldBench Protein-Protein Interaction DockQ Pass
benchmarks.description: FoldBench general Protein-Protein Interaction — 278/279 PPI targets, DockQ ≥0.23 pass-rate. Higher=better.

benchmarks.name: FoldBench Protein-Ligand Pass
benchmarks.description: FoldBench Protein-Ligand binding pose — 511/518 protein-ligand targets, success rate from Runs N' Poses metric. Higher=better.

benchmarks.name: FoldBench Protein-DNA DockQ Pass
benchmarks.description: FoldBench Protein-DNA complex — 273/333 protein-DNA targets, DockQ pass-rate. Higher=better.

benchmarks.name: FoldBench Protein-Peptide DockQ Pass
benchmarks.description: FoldBench Protein-Peptide complex — 16/51 protein-peptide targets, DockQ pass-rate. Higher=better.

benchmarks.name: FoldBench Monomer LDDT
benchmarks.description: FoldBench protein monomer LDDT — 333/334 monomer targets. LDDT score (0-100), higher=better. MSA variant.

benchmarks.name: Megascale ΔG Spearman
benchmarks.description: Spearman correlation between predicted and measured ΔG (folding stability) on Megascale holdout (Foldseek-resplit, 47 train / 13 val / 50 test families). Higher=better.

benchmarks.name: Recent-PDB PPI DockQ Pass
benchmarks.description: Held-out Recent-PDB Protein-Protein Interaction set (post-training cutoff). DockQ pass-rate. Higher=better. Companion validation set to FoldBench PPI.
